recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型細胞具有豐富灰藍色細胞質、偶有細顆粒與偽足樣邊緣，核為圓形到腎形或摺疊、染色質細緻如花邊，符合單核母細胞與前單核球為主的急性單核球性白血病。
features: Large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules and irregular pseudopod-like borders
Round, oval to reniform or folded nuclei
Delicate lacy chromatin with occasional nucleoli
Low to moderate N:C ratio compared with myeloblasts
Monotonous population with few maturing granulocytes; dense red cell background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a monotonous population of large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules in some cells and irregular cytoplasmic borders. Nuclei are round to reniform or folded with delicate lacy chromatin and occasional nucleoli. Maturing neutrophil lineage cells are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Requires at least 20% neutrophil lineage cells with MPO-positive blasts, whereas this field is dominated by monocytic cells.
Microgranular APL has bilobed or butterfly nuclei, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts are MPO weak/negative and NSE positive.
In CMML monocytes are mature with condensed chromatin and blasts plus promonocytes are below 20%.
